“I say my life is worth something,
You can say yours is worthwhile too,
But I bet you never have to convince anyone,
To see from your point of view” (paraphrase, listening on the commute). Mavis Staples #BLM 
Nice to hear @ErrolNazareth on @metromorning!

@ErrolNazareth @Breeganism As a teacher I’m always aware of this amongst young Ss, take care to challenge racist/sexist/ableist talk.
My own son got an earful a few years ago for saying “all lives...” in our house. I don’t think he’ll ever make that mistake again 😏 #BLM

@mikiebarb In fact, a look at the reception Shannon received during her training (ie more like hazing) and at the reception she gave her trainee from Mexico. The humanity is spelled out so beautifully. This year (eg #metoo) comes into focus when seeing through that lens.

@apihtawikosisan Interesting- I’ve seen solidarity between #idlenomore and #BlackLivesMatter, at least here in Toronto. Online too, POC more supportive of #resist150 bc of shared history of colonialism. But I’m outside both communities , don’t see  same things.
